recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, two-part composition featuring a large, pale pink header block with centered serif typography above a square-format photograph of a group in a lush, wooded setting.
coreVisualRelationships: Top-heavy typographic hierarchy against a grounded photographic base
Soft pastel background color contrasting with the organic greens and browns of the forest
Horizontal alignment between the main title and the primary tree branch
Visual balance between the four subjects positioned at varying heights within the tree

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The photographic subject occupies the bottom 60% of the frame, featuring four individuals interacting with a large horizontal tree branch.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, thin-serif title text in the upper third of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the large title, moves up to the secondary metadata, then drops down to the group portrait, following the diagonal lines of the tree branches.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the top third provided by the solid pastel background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pale pink background for the upper section.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Natural greens and earthy browns within the photography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, low-saturation header versus medium-value, medium-saturation photography.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid vibrant primary colors in the header

letterConstructionRules: Main title uses extremely high-contrast serifs with thin hairlines
Secondary text uses wide-tracked, all-caps geometric sans-serif
Metadata uses small, centered, all-caps sans-serif with bullet separators
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' in the main title features a graceful, curved leg
The 'A' has a sharp, pointed apex
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the title paired with a clean, bold sans-serif for the artist name to create a sophisticated, editorial look.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, elegant serif style of the main title.
Provides the clean, geometric structure for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution photograph of a group of four people in eclectic, stylish clothing posing around a large, mossy horizontal tree branch in a sun-dappled forest. Crop the image to a square and place it at the bottom of a vertical canvas. Fill the top 40% of the canvas with a solid, pale pastel pink color.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using a Modern Serif font like Didot, center the main title in the pink section. Above it, add the artist name in a bold geometric sans-serif with wide tracking. At the very top, add a three-line tracklist in a tiny sans-serif font, separated by dots.

verificationChecks: Is the pink header exactly the same width as the photo?
Is the main title text centered both horizontally and vertically within its space?
Is the tracking on the sans-serif text noticeably wide?
Does the photography have a soft, natural light quality?

adjustableVariables: Ratio of text block to photo
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text overlaps the image boundary
Check that the pink color is not too saturated
Verify that the serif hairlines are visible and not lost in compression
Confirm the square format is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid pastel header + High-contrast serif title + Wide-tracked sans-serif subtitle + Square organic photography.
